scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/relay && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && bun run --cwd packages/web build
scripts.dev:relay: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w packages/relay
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && bun run --cwd packages/web dev
scripts.test:relay: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w packages/relay
scripts.fetch:historical: npm run build:shared && npm run fetch:historical -w packages/relay
scripts.gen:synthetic: npm run build:shared && npm run gen:synthetic -w packages/relay
scripts.import:fixture: npm run build:shared && npm run import:fixture -w packages/relay --
